capabilities: Preview Marp slides live while editing
Present decks fullscreen or in a popout window
Show a presenter view with speaker notes and timer
Toggle a laser pointer during presentations
Export slides to HTML, PDF, PNG, and editable PPTX
extras: Desktop only; export requires a separately installed Marp CLI (and a Chromium browser for PDF/PNG/PPTX), while editable PPTX works without them. Sends diagram sources to Kroki over HTTPS only for slides containing Kroki blocks.
intentEvidence: This plugin is a fork of samuele-cozzi/obsidian-marp-slides with added presentation features and an editable PPTX export.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn Markdown notes into Marp slide decks with a presenter view, laser pointer, or PowerPoint export.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a fork of samuele-cozzi/obsidian-marp-slides with added presentation features
Marp — the Markdown-to-slides ecosystem (Marp Core, Marp CLI, Marpit)

summary: Marp slide plugin that live-previews Markdown decks, presents fullscreen or popout with a presenter view and laser pointer, and exports to HTML, PDF, PNG, and PPTX.
